_about: Sir James Black Baillie (1872-1940), Scottish Hegelian, professor of moral philosophy at Aberdeen. Not Robert Baillie the Covenanter (shelf robert-baillie). Raw IA OCR: The Origin and Significance of Hegel's Logic (Macmillan, 1901); An Outline of the Idealistic Construction of Experience (Macmillan, 1906); Studies in Human Nature (1922). His translation of Hegel's Phenomenology of Mind (1910) is translator work and is not taken here. US public domain. No uids minted.
